embedded-c-programming--static-ram.title: DRAM against SRAM
embedded-c-programming--static-ram.note: The refresh requirement separates the two; SRAM spends area to avoid it.

embedded-c-programming--prom.title: one-time and reprogrammable ROM
embedded-c-programming--prom.note: Erase granularity, not programmability, is what separates these parts.

embedded-c-programming--tcon.title: TCON bits at 88H
embedded-c-programming--tcon.note: TCON is bit-addressable, so a flag is tested without masking the whole byte.

embedded-c-programming--tmod.title: TMOD mode encoding
embedded-c-programming--tmod.note: GATE lets a pin gate the run bit; C/T counts edges instead of machine cycles.

embedded-c-programming--bdata-area.title: bit-addressable BDATA
embedded-c-programming--bdata-area.note: sbit names one bit of the byte, so the compiler emits a bit instruction.

embedded-c-programming--isr.title: timer 0 interrupt handler
embedded-c-programming--isr.note: The number after interrupt binds the function to a vector, so no address is written by hand.

embedded-c-programming--switch-bounce.title: debouncing a switch
lines: if (SW == 0) {          /* still closed: a real press */
embedded-c-programming--switch-bounce.note: The second read, taken after the bounce window, turns a noisy edge into one event.

embedded-c-programming--modular-programm.title: module-private state
lines: static unsigned int ticks;          /* file scope only */
embedded-c-programming--modular-programm.note: static is the private member; the plain function is the only door into the module.

embedded-c-programming--typedef.title: typedef aliases
lines: typedef unsigned int  word;     /* 16-bit on the 8051 */
typedef bit           flag;     /* one BDATA bit */
embedded-c-programming--typedef.note: The alias is a type, so it declares variables and stands in prototypes unchanged.
